data.narrative:
Specter Aerospace is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company founded by Felipe Gomez del Campo and Drew Weibel, having raised $14.4M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a comp universe of 6 private peers at same or adjacent stages (Sierra Space at $8.0B Series C; Apex Space at $2.3B Series D; Cowboy Space Corporation at $2.0B Series B; Varda Space Industries at $1.6B Series D; Aalyria at $1.3B Series B) and 5 public aerospace names (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a median 27.4x price-to-sales.

Two methods produced quantifiable outputs. Stage-progression analysis applying a 1.7x multiplier to the $14.4M total raised proxy yielded $24M. Peer-median triangulation across the six same-sector comparables produced $1.8B, with the range spanning $1.1B to $8.0B. Public-comp anchoring was not applicable due to absence of disclosed revenue for the target. The public comp set carries limited direct utility absent revenue disclosure.

The triangulated range spans $21M (floor from stage-progression) to $2.1B (peer-median plus dispersion), with a median implied value of $907M. This wide range reflects material uncertainty around the target's progress on operational milestones, technology validation, and revenue trajectory relative to the peer set. The peer median of $1.8B and triangulated median of $907M should be treated as indicative anchors subject to verification of company-specific development stage and customer traction.
